name: Maria Silva
bio:
Maria Silva's journey into motorsport finance was somewhat unconventional, stemming from her early career in auditing for a large Lisbon-based bank. She always had a keen eye for detail and a knack for spotting inconsistencies, skills that proved invaluable when she transitioned to the high-octane world of racing. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, Maria saw an opportunity to combine her financial expertise with her passion for cars and competition. 

While relatively new to the specific nuances of motorsport finance, Maria brings a fresh perspective and unwavering dedication. She is meticulous in her approach, ensuring every transaction is accounted for and every budget is meticulously managed. Maria is determined to prove herself in this demanding environment, constantly seeking ways to optimize financial processes and contribute to the team's success. Her ambitious nature drives her to learn quickly and adapt to the fast-paced rhythm of the sport.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Maria is a woman of average height with a warm, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with financial calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen when concentrating.
Insists on using a vintage calculator for initial budget drafts.
